citation.title: Holdaway soft tissue cephalometric standards for Saudi adults
citation.journal: King Saud University Journal of Dental Sciences

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare a vs b exit 0: all 33 entries agree on measurement, sex, age band, mean, SD, n, unit, source and definitionMatch; the tool compares no prose). Every value re-read from the page images of Table 1 (p. 29, PDF p. 3) and Table 2 (p. 30, PDF p. 4): agree. Set fields settled (merge notes; the tool does not compare them): modality a 'digital', b 'film' → film (the films were scanned, Epson 4990, p. 28); headPosition a 'FH', b 'unknown' → unknown (ear rods and head holder; FH or NHP not stated, p. 28); scale → true-size, 'p. 28: calibrated in Dolphin' (ruling P27; both extractions pre-date the scale field and wrote magnificationCorrected: true); openAccess a and b true → false: the PDF prints a 2011 King Saud University copyright notice (hosted by Elsevier, all rights reserved) and no open-access licence (p. 27). Authors as 'AlBarakati SF' (the existing Holdaway set's spelling; the paper's running head prints 'ALBarakati'). SS depth pooled SD 1.37 (Tables 1 and 3) vs 1.367 (Table 2) → 1.37, noted on the pooled row. Signs: none stated in the paper; Holdaway's convention, as the catalogue (which takes its #73-#83 definitions from this paper). Saudi columns only: Holdaway's own column is holdaway1983-via-albarakati2012; the Turkish and Japanese columns of Table 3 are not entered.

caveats: Sample: 61 Saudi adults aged 20-24 (30 women, 31 men), King Saud University, Riyadh; Class I molar and canine, normal overjet and overbite, no crowding, competent lips, no previous orthodontic or orthognathic treatment (p. 28); the abstract (p. 27) describes Class I occlusion with a balanced facial profile. Mean age not given.

Films scanned (Epson Perfection 4990) and traced in Dolphin 11; magnification was corrected by calibrating against a known distance between two points on the Dolphin ruler (p. 28), so mm values are taken as true size (ruling P27).
Head position: set by the ear rods and the head holder (p. 28); FH or NHP not stated. Lips at rest, teeth in occlusion.
Sign conventions are not stated in the paper; signs follow Holdaway 1983 as the catalogue does. Table 1's minima of −4.5 mm (convexity) and −4.2 mm (LL-H line) show these are signed measures.
Table 1 also prints the sample's minimum and maximum for each variable; these are observed extremes of 61 people, not a norm range, and are not entered.
#79 Upper lip strain is not a row in Tables 1-3; not entered (not computed from #77 and #78).
Holdaway's own values (Table 3) are the separate set holdaway1983-via-albarakati2012; the Anatolian Turkish and Japanese (Alcalde 2000) columns of Table 3 are restatements and are not entered here.

entries.note: Paper row 'Convexity (mm)'. The paper defines it as the distance from point A to the bony nasion–pogonion line (Na-Pog) (Holdaway's skeletal profile convexity). Sign not stated; positive mean and Holdaway's convention read + when A is ahead, as the catalogue.
Paper row 'Face angle (°)'. Paper: inner angle of soft-tissue nasion to soft-tissue suprapogonion line with FH.
Paper row 'Nose prom (mm)'. Paper: line perpendicular to FH tangent to the upper-lip vermilion, to the tip of the nose.

Paper row 'SS depth (mm)'. Paper: upper-lip sulcus to a line perpendicular to FH through the vermilion. Positive = depth behind the line. Pooled SD: Table 1 and Table 3 print 1.37, Table 2 prints 1.367; 1.37 used (merge notes).
Paper row 'Sub-H line (mm)'. Paper: subnasale to H line. Positive = behind the line, as the catalogue.
Paper row 'UL-A point (mm)'. Paper: a point about 3 mm below point A to the drape of the upper lip.
Paper row 'UL-vermilion (mm)'. Paper: labial surface of upper incisors to the vermilion border of the upper lip.

Paper row 'H angle (°)'. Paper: angle of the H line to the soft-tissue facial plane. No sign rule is stated; every value is positive (Table 1 minimum 8.2°), stored as printed under the catalogue's + when the upper lip is ahead.

Paper row 'LL-H line (mm)'. Paper: lower lip to H line (tangent from chin to upper-lip vermilion). Sign not stated explicitly; discussion reads positive as 'more protrusive', i.e. + when ahead, as the catalogue.
Paper row 'IS-H line (mm)'. Paper: point of maximum curvature on the lower lip (inferior sulcus) to the H line. Positive = depth behind the line.
Paper row 'Chin thick (mm)'. Paper: between hard- and soft-tissue facial planes at the level of Ricketts' suprapogonion.
